page.overview:
What is The Killer?

The Killer as the witchers called it, or simply "The Trail" as it was more generally known, was a path encircling Kaer Morhen which was beset with obstacles and used by witchers to train and improve their running speed and controlled breathing techniques.

There is another route called "the trail" but that one leads through the forests of Kaedwen to the Lixela and is used by more than just witcher trainees.
